author: EnderTrevor
body:
Your Minecraft username: EnderTrevor
The reason you were temp-banned/ banned: Ban Evading with the account "MintChipsZz"
Why should you be unbanned from the server: I believe I should be unbanned from Avicus because I'd like to say this was a bit unfairly assessed. I will not ramble on and make you read more you shouldn't have to. Anyways, I will fully accept that I was ban evading. That does not mean I did ban evade considering I have never heard/used an account named MintChipsZz and I don't understand why it is linked to my IP. I believe that 50 days is enough for these terms and I would absolutely love to come back and play once again. Lastly, I truly believe in second chances and I believe that the Avicus staff team should wish to give me that chance. I wish to continue making memories here and I hope that whoever reads this wishes in doing so. Thank you for reading this far and have a nice day.

P.S.  If you need more just say so and I will gladly tell more. And one more thing, this was also meant for my alt ThyIsWorthy_ as it got banned for the same reason. This is not at all for the account MintChipsZz as that is not my account and that idiot should appeal himself.
